model_annotation: The image presents three side-by-side pie charts detailing the proportional breakdown of subcategories within three primary groups: "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive & Conjunctive." Instead of using an external legend, all category labels and precise percentage values are centered directly inside their corresponding slices in a bolded font. None of the slices across the three charts are exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized. The leftmost chart, titled "Categorical," is divided into four slices: "Universal Quantifiers" in light blue-grey at 29.07%, "Limiter" in light pink at 27.91%, "Negation" in light peach at 27.91%, and "Existential Quantifiers" in light green at 15.12%. The middle chart, "Approximate Number Generation," contains three slices arranged roughly counterclockwise in descending order of size, beginning with the light beige "Approximate Quantities" at 45.03%, followed by the light blue "Comparative Relationships" at 36.26%, and the light purple "Absolute Absence" at 18.71%. The rightmost chart, titled "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," is split vertically into two nearly equal segments consisting of "Conjunctive" at 50.49% in a light pinkish tone on the right and "Disjunctive" at 49.51% in a light grayish-blue tone on the left.
